body:
Your funds are safe.

You may see this error message below when tapping into your assets. This is only affecting the Earn feature within Edge that is used to stake assets for an annual percentage yield. Sending, receiving and all other wallet functionality is 100% working.

If you have staked funds or would like to create a stake to start earning passive crypto income, this issue will be resolved within the next 24-48 hours.

Please look for an update in your app store or on the Edge website (www.edge.app). You will want to be on 3.23.3 or higher to resolve this issue.
